question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Comprehend
solution:
The correct answer is **"Assimilate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Comprehend"** means to mentally grasp something's complete nature or meaning. (किसी चीज़ की संपूर्ण प्रकृति या अर्थ को मानसिक रूप से समझना)

 
 
• **Example**: *I fail to **comprehend**__ their attitude.*
 
 
 
• **"Assimilate"** means to understand or comprehend something fully. (किसी देश या सामाजिक समूह में सम्मिलित हो जाना या किसी अन्‍य को सम्मिलित कर लेना, समावेश करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The European Union should remain flexible enough to **assimilate**__ more countries quickly.*
 
 
 
• **Assimilate** is a synonym of **comprehend**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Distort** means to twist or change the meaning of something. (शकल या आवाज़ को बिगाड़ देना)
 
• **Deter** means to discourage or prevent someone from doing something. (किसी को कोई काम करने से रोकना (उसके संभावित दुष्‍परिणामों को देखते हुए))
 
• **Complex** means something that is difficult to understand. (अनेक परस्‍पर संबद्घ अंशों से निर्मित और प्रायः दुर्बोध; पेचीदा; जटिल)
